sn8.1:1.2: This chapter features the poetry of Vaṅgīsa, the finest poet of the Sangha. These discourses provide a prose setting for his Theragāthā verses at [thag21.1](). In several passages, including this one, he reflects on the struggles he faced in his path, showing a high degree of self-awareness and persistence.
sn8.1:1.4: Period art depicts women as bare-breasted and draped in elaborate jewellery.
sn8.1:1.5: “Dissatisfaction” (_anabhirati_) with his life of seclusion and celibacy.
